info.name: HR System API
info.description:
Run order: 0 Setup -> 1 Auth/Login -> 2 Designation -> 3 Role -> 4 LeaveType -> 5 Employee -> 6 LeaveRequests -> others.
Cookies (access_token / refresh_token) are stored automatically by Postman after Login. Access token lives 15 min: run Auth > Refresh if you get 401.
IDs returned by create requests are saved into collection variables automatically.

item.name: 0 Setup (run once)
item.description: Run this once on an empty database.

request.description: Works ONLY while there are zero employees. Needs BOOTSTRAP_SECRET in .env.local. Creates org + ROLE_ADMIN (['*','system.admin']) + DES_ADMIN + admin employee. Remove BOOTSTRAP_SECRET afterwards.
If you run this, update the adminPassword variable afterwards.
Paste the token from the emailed link (?token=...) into the resetToken variable. Same call is used for the first-time password setup link.
Fails with 409 while employees use it.

item.name: 3 Role
item.description: Allowed permissions: * employee.read employee.create employee.update employee.delete role.read role.manage designation.manage leaveType.manage leave.read_all leave.approve candidate.read candidate.manage organization.manage system.admin

request.description: Fails with 409 while employees use it.

item.name: 4 LeaveType (create BEFORE employees)
item.description: Creating a leave type also creates balances for all active employees.

request.description: Also adjusts this year's balances by the difference.
Fails with 409 if leave requests exist.
No password in body. A setup link is emailed (valid 48h). If SMTP is not configured the employee is still created (email_sent:false).
Needs leave.approve and you CANNOT approve your own request: login as a different user (e.g. HR Manager) first.
Soft cancel. Pending releases the reservation, approved restores used days.
system.admin sees all; others see only their own.
Only when the organization has no employees.
